decisions.reason: Because the GA4 tracking plugin was only mentioned in 2023 and disappeared from the 2024 website, management would read it as failing to justify continued standalone attention relative to aspirations and would reallocate those resources.

Because the Universal Analytics plugin vanished from the website after 2023 and the underlying analytics standard became obsolete, its results likely fell clearly below aspiration so dropping it is the boundedly rational choice.

Because the retail system interface plugin was no longer presented in 2024, management would infer weak demand or insufficient fit with expected returns and shift the released specialist capacity to stronger offerings.

Because the shop relaunch SEO support service kept its own page in both 2023 and 2024, it appears to meet or exceed aspiration levels and fits the firm's core bundled e-commerce consulting capabilities.

Because the SEO workshops were newly launched in 2024 and already received their own page, organisational slack in a growing market supports keeping them on the market while their performance is still being learned.
